facts.title: obsessively good avocado cucumber salad
ingredients: 3/4 to 1 pound seedless cucumber, washed and chopped into chunks
2 thin or 1 regular scallions, thinly sliced
Juice of half a lime, plus more to taste
Salt and hot sauce to taste
Chopped cilantro or flat-leaf parsley to garnish
facts.yield_text: Serves 2 as a main or 4 as a side
facts.author: Deb Perelman
